ontology.name: French-Door Refrigerator
ontology.description: Canonical functional diagnostic ontology for French-door refrigerators. Models functional relationships and diagnostic dependencies; manufacturer, platform, compartment, and drive-architecture implementations belong in overlays.
ontology.frozenNote: CG-7 rev1 — three-manual discovery (W10322959 Jazz, SAMSUNG-RF23BB, LG-LRMVS). Six KEEP components; five CONDITIONAL concepts in ontology contract only; three aggregates removed; four platform-only; six deferred.

designPrinciples: Model functional refrigeration behavior — not physical sealed-system topology or manufacturer-specific board architectures.
Separate power, control, user interface, temperature control, cooling actuation, airflow distribution, defrost, and optional features (ice/water) diagnostically.
door_switch is door authorization / light / service-mode sensing — distinct from lid_lock or mechanical door mechanisms on other appliance families.
evaporator_fan and defrost_heater may have multiple compartment-scoped instances; canonical nodes accept instance overlay bindings.

CONDITIONAL concepts (temperature_sensor, compressor, condenser_fan, ice_maker, water_dispenser) are evidence-backed functional roles that are not universally instantiated — they do not appear in components[] until overlay binding supplies scope.
Removed aggregates (airflow_path, defrost_system, cooling_system) decompose to member actuators on all discovery manuals — do not reintroduce at canonical layer.
Platform-only vocabulary (compressor_controller, defrost_sensor, water_inlet_valve, sealed_system) must not auto-promote from overlay exposure.
Manufacturer-specific implementations (Jazz board, inverter PBA, linear compressor, compartment NTC naming) extend via overlays — they do not replace canonical function.
Tests produce evidence; evidence changes component and hypothesis state (handled in procedure + intelligence layers).
Do not condemn a downstream actuator until required upstream control and authorization conditions are established.
Unknown information must remain unknown — never infer good or bad without evidence.
Procedure branch logic and test definitions stay in service procedure seeds, not in this file.

ontologyContract.canonicalComponentRule: components[] lists only triangulated KEEP nodes with 3-manufacturer functional recurrence and universal diagnostic role within the French-door refrigeration family.
ontologyContract.conditionalConceptRule: Evidence-backed functional role that is not universally instantiated and requires overlay binding or instance scope before graph participation.
ontologyContract.instanceSemanticsRule: When mayHaveInstances is true, overlays bind compartment or feature scope (e.g. fresh_food, freezer, convert, icing) — the canonical node identity is stable; instances are overlay-scoped, not separate canonical components.
ontologyContract.notEveryApplianceHasOne: A conditional concept means the function exists across the appliance family — not that every appliance has exactly one component with that identity.

conditionalConcepts.freezeRationale: Compartment/function-specific sensing triangulated on all three manuals — generic undifferentiated sensor does not survive.
Refrigeration heat-pump actuator role recurs; drive path is platform implementation — never collapse compressor_controller into canonical compressor.
2/3 standalone diagnostic exposure (Whirlpool + LG; Samsung absent) — conditional until broader refrigerator corpus confirms.
Optional feature domain — Samsung + LG evidence; Jazz absent. Do not require every French-door refrigerator to instantiate.
Optional through-door dispense feature — Samsung + LG evidence; Jazz absent.

removedFromRev1.reason: No independent diagnostic meaning across three manuals — redundant with fan + damper members.
Manuals consistently decompose defrost into heater, sensor, and control paths.
Aggregate adds no diagnostic discrimination beyond compressor, fan, and defrost members.

overlayOnlyConcepts.reason: Relay vs inverter vs linear drive electronics — platform overlay on all three manuals.
Compartment-specific termination vocabulary (bimetal, F-DEF/R-DEF, F dS/r dS) — not a single canonical sensor.
Water path tied to dispenser/ice feature hardware — no standalone inlet valve diagnostic on discovery manuals.
LG E CH/E CL aggregate diagnostic — do not turn LG platform vocabulary into universal canonical abstraction.

deferredConcepts.reason: Implied-only on all three manuals — no independent supply-path service test.
Physical component — no component-level diagnostic procedure.
Physical component — no component-level diagnostic procedure.
Samsung-only humidity-sensor procedure; LG mechanical crisper only.

componentStateModel.description: Component verification states for this ontology. Distinct from intelligence-engine hypothesis ranking.
componentStateModel.engineSeparationNote: Diagnostic ranking, candidate support, and routing effects do not constitute component verification. verified_good and verified_failed require explicit diagnostic evidence.

systems.name: Control
systems.purpose: Command, sequencing, monitoring, and refrigeration decision logic.

systems.name: User Interface
systems.purpose: User input, display, status, and service-mode entry.

systems.name: Door Authorization
systems.purpose: Door-closed authorization, lighting, and service-mode gating.

systems.name: Airflow Distribution
systems.purpose: Compartment evaporator airflow and fresh-food damper control.

systems.name: Defrost
systems.purpose: Defrost heater actuation and ice removal support.

components.name: Door Switch
components.note: Door authorization / lighting — distinct from mechanical lock or latch mechanisms.

instanceSemantics.note: Multi-fan topology is normal — bind compartment scope in platform overlay, not as separate canonical components.

components.name: Air Damper
components.note: Fresh-food airflow control — implementation surfaces differ (service test, damper heater, test-mode close).

instanceSemantics.note: Compartment-scoped defrost heaters are overlay instances of this canonical actuator.

relationships.note: Door authorization — distinct from lock/latch mechanisms.
Functional airflow distribution — hose/tower routing belongs in overlay.
Feedback path placeholder — compartment temperature response established via conditional temperature_sensor overlay.

functionalDependencies.description: Service-mode entry and door-light behavior require control readiness and door switch feedback.
Compartment cooling airflow requires control command and fan actuation; fresh-food paths may require damper position.
Defrost heater actuation requires control command — termination sensing is platform overlay (defrost_sensor).
Cooling requires control, airflow, and compressor (conditional overlay binding for drive implementation).
functionalDependencies.note: compressor is conditional — bind relay/inverter/linear implementation in platform overlay.

general.rule: Establish control readiness and door authorization before condemning cooling actuators.
Separate control command evidence from load operation evidence.
Verify fan and damper paths before treating sealed-system faults.
Do not instantiate conditional concepts as verified components without platform overlay scope.
Negative or incomplete evidence should reduce candidate support without manufacturing verification.

control_board.note: R2 withheld premature R1 promotion — Samsung boundary required third vote.

user_interface.note: HMI confirmed on Samsung; freeze blocked until R3.

door_switch.note: Multi-door Samsung switches — functional role held, naming differs.

humanFreezeReview.conditionalOntologyContractRule: Conditional concepts encoded in ontologyContract + conditionalConcepts[] — not promoted to components[] during rev1 authoring.
